create.name: Lotos-Vihara
create.bio:
Lotos-Vihara is a Buddhist meditation centre in the Mitte district of Berlin, a short walk from Alexanderplatz, that teaches across the main Buddhist traditions rather than within one. It was set up as a non-profit association in 1997 by Dr. Wilfried Reuter, Jutta Kadegge and a small sangha, and Dr. Reuter remains its spiritual director. Formerly a physician, he names the nun Ayya Khema as his most important teacher, also studied with Tarab Tulku and Lene Handberg, and was asked by Ayya Khema to teach the Dharma in Berlin; he also leads sister centres in Meißen, Augsburg, Bremen and Kempten. The centre belongs to the German Buddhist Union.

Meditation is offered almost every day, on site and over Zoom: morning sittings, samatha, vipassana and metta evenings, a young people's group and sound-and-silence evenings, with Dr. Reuter's talk and meditation on Sunday evenings. There are seasonal retreats, a modular Buddhist study programme, personal retreats in guest apartments, a library and a vegetarian café. The YouTube channel, running since 2011, carries his Sunday talks in German with the guided meditations that follow them.

courses.title: Silvesterretreat mit Dr. Wilfried Reuter und Mantra-Gruppe
courses.description: A four-day New Year retreat in Berlin, also joinable online, with meditation, Dhamma talks and mantra singing, and yoga twice a day. Led by Dr. Wilfried Reuter.

courses.title: Studienprogramm 2027 - Buddhistische Praxis und Beziehungen
courses.description: Three weekend modules through 2027 on bringing Buddhist practice into relationships, from the relationship with oneself to meeting others and freedom within relationships. Hybrid, recorded, and run with the Anjali Foundation.

free_resources.title: Sonntagabend mit Dr. Wilfried Reuter
free_resources.description: The centre's Sunday evening of meditation and a Dhamma talk, held in Berlin and open to join over Zoom.
